items.desc: Live, multi-camera object tracking with SAM3, SAM 2 and EdgeTAM, on one GPU or many. One model per GPU serves every camera: faster than the original code, about 4x less GPU memory, identical masks.

Skills that teach Claude Code to be a first-pass video editor in DaVinci Resolve: transcript cuts, vlog pacing, B-roll, music & SFX, clean captions, motion graphics, YouTube export. CC BY-NC 4.0 (no commercial use).

Open-source NotebookLM alternative. Chat with your sources with citations, and turn them into reports, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps and slide decks, with your own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key or local Ollama / LM Studio models. Local-first, no account.
